title: Multi-domain source-held-out real-gold classifier (Qwen teacher -> Potion)
question: On a harder multi-domain benchmark where the primary test set is source-held-out from training/teacher/calibration, how do a calibrated Qwen3.8-flash teacher and a Potion classifier trained on Qwen labels (not real gold) compare on the same untouched real-gold test set, and what error pattern does one controlled iteration address?
